title: Telegram Task Orchestrator Roadmap
goal: Let Telegram act as the remote operator surface for long-running Odysseus tasks without requiring constant manual supervision.
example_requests: analysiere die asv bw hilfeseite vollstaendig und fasse alle informationen im gedaechtnis zusammen
zeige mir die wichtigsten offenen entscheidungen

slice_queue.goal: Normalize Telegram messages into trusted task intents with channel, operator, target kind, requested output and live gate needs.
Create a redacted run ledger for task state, progress, gates, retries and operator-visible summaries.
Return concise Telegram updates for started, waiting-for-gate, running, blocked, done and failed states.
Support pause, resume, cancel, status and review commands without exposing raw private content in Telegram.

slice_queue.evidence: Debian live status reports agent_reply_ready, polling_enabled=true, agent_chat_enabled=true, reply_gate_enabled=true; task simulation resolves ASV BW request to website_research_to_memory without exposing token or chat id values.
slice_queue.goal: Verify that Telegram can create a bounded task and receive progress/status on Debian.
Treat todo, todos, aufgabe, aufgaben and zu erledigen as Todo-domain labels without allowing bare Todo vocabulary to trigger project intake.
acceptance: Label-style Todo requests with optional German due qualifiers route to manage_todos.
Bare Todo vocabulary without a project marker does not trigger project intake.
Explicit project markers and strong project-planning terms retain project-intake behavior.
The exact Telegram incident wording is covered by deterministic regression tests.
tests: venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_telegram_plugin.py tests/test_telegram_webhook_service.py tests/test_todo_intent_routing.py tests/test_manage_todos_wiring.py tests/test_telegram_project_intake.py
slice_queue.next_action: Review and commit the exact claimed paths, then request a separate deploy-live-go before updating or restarting Debian.

slice_queue.goal: Keep short German Telegram follow-ups bound to the immediately preceding topic and report provider failures honestly without leaking chat or provider content.
acceptance: The exact follow-up 'Welche Punkte sind das?' inherits the immediately preceding changes topic and selects the recent-changes capability.
A terminal provider HTTP or SSE error is never rendered as an empty model response.
Telegram uses only owner-approved chat fallback candidates and reports an explicit redacted provider failure if none succeeds.
Claim-evidence corrections identify the exact unsupported assertion in the current response.
Diagnostics contain only bounded counts, booleans and closed status codes.
tests: venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_telegram_followup_resilience.py tests/test_telegram_context_policy.py tests/test_claim_evidence_gate.py tests/test_agent_loop.py

Telegram status messages never include raw sensitive content.
